# Brandon University

> Brandon University is a comprehensive educational institution offering undergraduate and graduate programs, student services, and community engagement in Manitoba.

Brandon University serves future students, current students, alumni, and faculty with resources spanning admissions, academic support, scholarships, library services, and Indigenous education initiatives. The university is located in Brandon, Manitoba and provides both in-person and virtual engagement opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Admissions and Application Process
- Scholarships and Awards

## Admissions and Future Students

- [Future Students Hub](https://www.brandonu.ca/future-students): Future students hub covering admissions, campus visits, and student life
- [Admissions](https://www.brandonu.ca/future-students/apply): Application process, requirements, and deadlines for Brandon University
- [Programs](https://www.brandonu.ca/future-students/programs): Degree and certificate programs offered at Brandon University
- [International Students](https://www.brandonu.ca/future-students/apply/international): International student admissions process and requirements
- [Visit Us](https://www.brandonu.ca/future-students/visit): Campus visit options including tours and virtual visit requests

## Student Resources and Services

- [Current Students](https://www.brandonu.ca/current-students): Current student resources including services, registration, and academic support
- [Scholarships and Awards](https://www.brandonu.ca/scholarships): Scholarships, bursaries, and awards for all student levels
- [Services](https://www.brandonu.ca/services): Comprehensive listing of campus services for students and employees
- [John E. Robbins Library](https://www.brandonu.ca/library): University library services, resources, and research support
- [Registration Guides](https://www.brandonu.ca/registration): Course registration guides and student procedures documentation
- [Long Night Against Procrastination](https://www.brandonu.ca/longnight): Academic support event with extended library hours and writing help
